rationale: Raid tuning of 2026-10-08 (PR #251, branch raid-tuning at b7e57b5c, over main c5c29abc). CONTENT: cast vigor fp(3) -> fp(0.1875) against every mage's fp(1); hit-point family /16 and node.json direct-damage x4; summon blow /64; portal 150 +/- 30 ticks; stand-in rival armed with 2 nodes a raider, one primitive per slot, instead of 8; new raid constant raid-readiness-mastery-floor fp(0.625). CODE: a raid ends on its own terms only once no raider is on the field; action 14 and 16 count only usably held portal nodes (mastery >= activation), and 14 also needs a living raider and a seat holding a running universe; raid-readiness drills a raider's held combat/theft/portal nodes (raiders only); a raider's practice targets are her kit, practised up to the floor, and a raider with an uncastable kit node does not research; action 10 offers portal-node holders' raider slot first; a raid's own casualties are settled like ordinary deaths. Every run here is raided by stand-ins, which before could not kill and now kill about three mages an arrival (scripts/standin-lethality-probe.mjs: 0 -> 42 deaths in 14 arrivals, six seeds, 600 ticks). The movement is that behaviour landing on purpose, not a regression.
